writing.rule: Require a clean worktree before this profile replaces files from another branch.
writing.explanation:
Branches name positions in history. Creating a branch does not copy a folder, and switching it is not merely changing a label: the target tree can replace editor files. A clean-checkout policy is easy to explain and test. It refuses the operation whenever the current worktree differs from its HEAD, including an untracked file or deletion.

Compare trees without relying on their enumeration order. A new branch can be created while preserving current edits, but switching uses the clean-tree precondition in this terminal. A desktop client may support more nuanced preservation or stash; those are distinct contracts. After committing, refresh status before switching, because a successful commit of one captured snapshot does not prove newer typing was also committed.

The route project is Task Ledger: first keep a reproducible source history, then expose its data through a CLI and HTTP boundary, persist it in SQL, diagnose failures and prepare a release. This lesson owns one contract in that project. Run the worked example before changing the starter and explain which input makes the tempting shortcut fail.

Terminal practice: Run git branch feature-cli, git status, then git switch feature-cli after the tree is clean.

The compiler lab is independent of the reading question. Edit solution.rs; the app supplies a separate caller with normal, empty and adversarial inputs. A successful unchanged demonstration does not prove your implementation. After the lab, apply the same contract to the route companion project. Its README separates the on-device adapter from the desktop Cargo/TCP profile.

writing.success: The separate caller accepts the changed solution and rejects unchanged TODO, a wrong implementation and a printed success message.
writing.question: Can an untracked file matter to a clean-checkout policy?
answers: Only tracked modifications can make a checkout unsafe

writing.feedback: An added or deleted file is a tree difference even when tracked file contents match.
